title: stenoloma alutaceum
intro: Stenoloma alutaceum, commonly known as the alutaceum fern, is a species of fern in the family Lomariopsidaceae. This plant is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Stenoloma alutaceum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antibacterial, antifungal, and anti-cancer properties.
